sourceResolution: Renderer.Dispose iterates ComponentState.DisposeAsync; child render-batch removal calls DisposeInBatchAsync, which removes cascading subscriptions before DisposeAsync. Accepted probe will explicitly remove the reactivated children through the real render producer, then dispose the renderer. It will not claim renderer-wide disposal alone proves unsubscribe behavior.
